baseline.summary: Always-present starter foundations; these are not optional capability modules and must never appear in capability relationship arrays.

tanstack.summary: Evaluate for local-first collections and synchronized client data; do not install solely for roadmap coverage.
Evaluate as an implementation option for the AI capability without making it a baseline dependency.
Evaluate for the Command System when its API and accessibility fit are proven.
Evaluate for reusable throttling, debouncing, and rate control needs.
Evaluate for large Data Table and list surfaces.
Evaluate for the Charts capability when stable and appropriate.
Evaluate for Markdown and code content rendering.
Continue evaluating project hook reliability; on-demand discovery is currently available.

nuxt.summary: Prefer maintained Nuxt Modules when governing the equivalent Nuxt starter.
Evaluate composables for client capabilities rather than porting React-specific helpers.
Evaluate where Markdown and structured content requirements justify it.
Select Vue-native equivalents where TanStack-specific UI libraries are unsuitable.
